# The Wool Carts

*The highland wool carters are late, stuck on the rotten boardwalks of the Seepwater Foothills where the bog-lurchers have come up out of the reeds. Torvi asks you to clear 30 of them.*

## Objectives

- Defeat 30 [Bog-Lurcher](../monsters/bog_lurcher.md) in [Seepwater Foothills](../maps/seepwater_foothills.md)
